title: ExpertGen: Scalable Sim-to-Real Expert Policy Learning from Imperfect Behavior Priors
abstract: arXiv:2603.15956v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning generalizable and robust behavior cloning policies requires large volumes of high-quality robotics data. While human demonstrations (e.g., through teleoperation) serve as the standard source for expert behaviors, acquiring such data at scale in the real world is prohibitively expensive. This paper introduces ExpertGen, a framework that automates expert policy learning in simulation to enable scalable sim-to-real transfer. ExpertGen first initializes a behavior prior using a diffusion policy trained on imperfect demonstrations, which may be synthesized by large language models or provided by humans. Reinforcement learning is then used to steer this prior toward high task success by optimizing the diffusion model's initial noise while keep original policy frozen. translated_title: ExpertGen：从不完美行为先验中实现可扩展的仿真到现实专家策略学习
translated_abstract: 学习具有泛化性和鲁棒性的行为克隆策略需要大量高质量的机器人数据。虽然人类示教（例如通过遥操作）是专家行为的标准来源，但在现实世界中大规模获取此类数据的成本极其高昂。本文提出了ExpertGen，这是一个在仿真环境中自动化专家策略学习的框架，从而实现可扩展的仿真到现实迁移。ExpertGen首先使用在不完美示教数据上训练的扩散策略来初始化行为先验，这些示教数据可以由大语言模型合成或由人类提供。随后，通过强化学习优化扩散模型的初始噪声，同时保持原始策略冻结，将该行为先验引导至高任务成功率。通过保持预训练扩散策略冻结，ExpertGen将探索过程正则化，使其保持在安全、类人的行为流形之内，同时还能够……
tldr: 提出ExpertGen框架，以不完美示教训练的冻结扩散策略作为行为先验，仅通过强化学习优化扩散模型的初始噪声，实现可扩展的仿真到现实专家策略学习。
en_tdlr: ExpertGen enables scalable sim-to-real expert policy learning by using a frozen diffusion policy trained on imperfect demonstrations as a behavior prior, and steering it toward high task success via reinforcement learning that optimizes only the diffusion model's initial noise.
